fam.val.parse_error.hint: Fix the statement on the marked line; one statement per line.
fam.val.unknown_ref.hint: Declare the name with param or ref, or fix the spelling.
fam.val.formula_cycle: Formulas depend on each other in a loop
fam.val.formula_cycle.hint: Break the loop: one of the parameters must get a plain value.
fam.val.sketch_conflict.hint: Remove or relax one of the marked dimensions.
fam.val.sketch_underconstrained: Some reference planes are not fully defined
fam.val.sketch_underconstrained.hint: Add dim, eq or align, or pin the plane with '='.
fam.val.type_fails: A catalog type does not build
fam.val.type_fails.hint: Fix the type values or the formulas that use them.
fam.val.flex_fails: The family breaks when parameters change
fam.val.flex_fails.hint: Make the geometry follow the parameter, or add a limit.
fam.val.nonmanifold: A body is not a valid closed solid
fam.val.nonmanifold.hint: Fix the outline or the cut.
fam.val.zero_volume.hint: Give the body a positive size in every direction.
fam.val.too_large: The family is larger than allowed
fam.val.too_large.hint: Check the units of the lengths.
fam.val.budget: The definition exceeds the size budget
fam.val.budget.hint: Split it into smaller families or reduce the counts.
